mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate level (measured at t-1mo) compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of the months where FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a restrictive monetary policy that increases the discount rate for equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the months where FEDFUNDS is above 4.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals a weakening consumer economy, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the months where HOUST < 450.0 and RSAFS < 330000.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 7.0%), the Federal Reserve is likely to implement accommodative monetary policy, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of the months where UNRATE > 7.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) indicates stronger economic activity, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of the months where INDPRO is above 98.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts rate below 450,000 units (HOUST) signals a contraction in the housing sector, which is a leading indicator of economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the months where HOUST < 450.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 215.0) and a rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 0.5%) signals a monetary policy tightening cycle, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the months where CPIAUCSL > 215.0 and FEDFUNDS > 0.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO < 97.0), the economy is entering a contraction phase, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the months where INDPRO < 97.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
